# Aliexpress (9 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /product | `product_id` / `url` | 5 | Get an AliExpress product by id or URL |
| /search | `query` | 5 | Search AliExpress products |
| /product/similar | `product_id` / `url` / `query` | 5 | Get similar AliExpress products |
| /reviews | `product_id` / `url` | **5-9** | Get AliExpress product reviews |
| /product/shipping | `sku_id`, `product_id` / `url` | 5 | Get AliExpress shipping for a product SKU |
| /search/hot | `query`?, `page`?, `page_size`?, `sort_by`?, … | 5 | List hot AliExpress products |
| /search/promo | `promotion_name` | 5 | List AliExpress products in a featured promotion |
| /categories | *(none)* | 1 | List AliExpress categories |
| /promo | *(none)* | 1 | List AliExpress featured promotions |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- `a`? — the spec marks nothing required, but these are the parameters the endpoint accepts;
  a bare call usually will not work. See Endpoint Details for which combination to send.
- *(none)* — takes no parameters at all.
- A method prefix (**POST**, **DELETE**, **PATCH**) marks a non-GET endpoint; unmarked rows are GET.
- Every endpoint also accepts the `Cache-Control` header (send `no-cache` to bypass the
  response cache — billed at the normal rate) and `Idempotency-Key` (a UUID that makes a
  retry safe; a replay returns the cached payload without double-billing).

## Endpoint Details

_What each endpoint returns and when to reach for it._

### /product — 5cr

Returns one AliExpress product: title, sale price, original price, currency, shop name, images, sold count, and category. Pass the numeric product id or the full aliexpress.com/item/{id} URL. Optional country, currency, and language localise the price. A product that does not exist, or is not sold to that country, comes back 404 and is not billed. There is no product description on this surface. For reviews call GET /v1/aliexpress/reviews. For similar items call GET /v1/aliexpress/product/similar.

**Parameters**

- `country` *(optional)*: Ship-to country as a two-letter code. Default US. Changes displayed price and availability. A product that exists for US can return empty for another country.
- `currency` *(optional)*: ISO 4217 currency for displayed prices. Default USD. Live-validated: USD GBP CAD EUR UAH MXN TRY RUB BRL AUD INR JPY IDR SEK KRW ILS THB CLP VND.
- `language` *(optional)*: Copy language as an ISO code. Default EN. Live-validated: EN RU PT ES FR ID IT TH JA AR VI TR DE HE KO NL PL MX CL IN.
- `product_id` / `url` — at least one required.
  - `product_id`: AliExpress product id, the numeric id in a product URL: aliexpress.com/item/3256812847028710.html is product id 3256812847028710. Product ids also come back on every row of GET /v1/aliexpress/search and GET /v1/aliexpress/search/hot. (one of: product_id, url; at least one required)
  - `url`: Full AliExpress product URL, for example https://www.aliexpress.com/item/3256812847028710.html. The product id is extracted from the path. (one of: product_id, url; at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/aliexpress/product?product_id=<product_id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /search — 5cr

Returns AliExpress products matching a keyword, 10 per page by default (max 50). Each row has product id, title, sale price, shop name, and image. Pass the returned cursor back until has_more is false. Optional sort_by: price_low, price_high, most_sold, least_sold. Optional min_price and max_price are in the smallest currency unit (cents). A query that matches nothing comes back empty and is not billed.

**Parameters**

- `query`: Search keywords, for example xiaomi or wireless earbuds.
- `page` *(optional)*: Page number, starting at 1. Prefer the universal cursor parameter. Native upstream cursor param. Send the universal `cursor` instead: the API maps it to this name for you.
- `page_size` *(optional)*: Products per page, 1 to 50. Default 10.
- `sort_by` *(optional)*: Result ordering: price_low, price_high, most_sold, or least_sold.
- `min_price` *(optional)*: Lowest price to include, in the smallest unit of the target currency (cents for USD).
- `max_price` *(optional)*: Highest price to include, in the smallest unit of the target currency (cents for USD).
- `category_id` *(optional)*: AliExpress category id. Category ids come from GET /v1/aliexpress/categories.
- `delivery_days` *(optional)*: Keep products that claim delivery within this many days.
- `country` *(optional)*: Ship-to country as a two-letter code. Default US. Changes displayed price and availability. A product that exists for US can return empty for another country.
- `currency` *(optional)*: ISO 4217 currency for displayed prices. Default USD. Live-validated: USD GBP CAD EUR UAH MXN TRY RUB BRL AUD INR JPY IDR SEK KRW ILS THB CLP VND.
- `language` *(optional)*: Copy language as an ISO code. Default EN. Live-validated: EN RU PT ES FR ID IT TH JA AR VI TR DE HE KO NL PL MX CL IN.
- `cursor` *(optional)*: Universal pagination cursor. Send `pagination.next_cursor` from the previous response back verbatim: the API maps it to this endpoint's native `page` (page style). You never construct, decode, or look up a cursor. Omit it for page 1.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/aliexpress/search?query=<query>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /product/similar — 5cr

Returns products similar to a source product id, or to a keyword if no product id is passed. 10 per page by default. Product id takes precedence over query when both are set.

- `page_size` *(optional)*: Products per page, 1 to 50. Default 10.
- `sort_by` *(optional)*: Result ordering: price_low, price_high, most_sold, or least_sold.
- `country` *(optional)*: Ship-to country as a two-letter code. Default US. Changes displayed price and availability. A product that exists for US can return empty for another country.
- `currency` *(optional)*: ISO 4217 currency for displayed prices. Default USD. Live-validated: USD GBP CAD EUR UAH MXN TRY RUB BRL AUD INR JPY IDR SEK KRW ILS THB CLP VND.
- `language` *(optional)*: Copy language as an ISO code. Default EN. Live-validated: EN RU PT ES FR ID IT TH JA AR VI TR DE HE KO NL PL MX CL IN.
- `cursor` *(optional)*: Universal pagination cursor. Send `pagination.next_cursor` from the previous response back verbatim: the API maps it to this endpoint's native `page` (page style). You never construct, decode, or look up a cursor. Omit it for page 1.
- `product_id` / `url` / `query` — at least one required.
  - `product_id`: AliExpress product id, the numeric id in a product URL: aliexpress.com/item/3256812847028710.html is product id 3256812847028710. Product ids also come back on every row of GET /v1/aliexpress/search and GET /v1/aliexpress/search/hot. (one of: product_id, url, query; at least one required)
  - `url`: Full AliExpress product URL, for example https://www.aliexpress.com/item/3256812847028710.html. The product id is extracted from the path. (one of: product_id, url, query; at least one required)
  - `query`: Keywords used when no product_id is passed. (one of: product_id, url, query; at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/aliexpress/product/similar?product_id=<product_id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /reviews — 5-9cr

Returns written customer reviews for an AliExpress product, 20 per page, each with text, translated text when present, star rating, reviewer name, country, date, and photo URLs. A product with no reviews comes back empty and is not billed. Optional filter: all, 1-5 (star), image, additional, local. Optional sort_by: default or newest. Pair filter=local with country to keep reviews from that country.

> ⚠️ **Metered: 5-9 credits a call — budget the 9 ceiling, not the low end.** Vendor label: 5-9 (metered): 5 credits per page. The default labels (sentiment, issue) are free. label=reports, incentivized or injection holds 4 extra credits and refunds down to 1 credit per started 25 reviews that were newly judged (the first 100 reviews of a page are judged): reviews already labelled are free, a page where nothing could be judged refunds the whole extra, and a cached page is free.

**Parameters**

- `page` *(optional)*: Page number, starting at 1. Prefer the universal cursor parameter. Native upstream cursor param. Send the universal `cursor` instead: the API maps it to this name for you.
- `filter` *(optional)*: Keep all reviews, only one star value (1-5), only reviews with photos (image), additional comments, or local reviews for country.
- `sort_by` *(optional)*: Review ordering: default or newest.
- `country` *(optional)*: Reviewer country when filter=local. Default US.
- `language` *(optional)*: Copy language as an ISO code. Default EN. Live-validated: EN RU PT ES FR ID IT TH JA AR VI TR DE HE KO NL PL MX CL IN.
- `label` *(optional)*: Optional CSV of SocialCrawl labels to add to every review. Without this param every page already carries sentiment and issue, free; label= adds the labels you name to them (the defaults keep running). sentiment and issue are free when asked for too; reports, incentivized and injection add 1 credit per started 25 newly judged reviews. judgments=off (or label=none) turns the default labels off. They read the review's title and text, never its stars. sentiment: how the reviewer feels, on five levels (level 0 to 4, score_0_1, confidence), plus rating_mismatch, true when the words clearly contradict the star rating (a glowing text under 1 star, a furious one under 5), null when the review has no rating. issue: the main problem the review reports (label: product_defect, sizing_or_fit, shipping_or_delivery, customer_service, price_or_value, missing_feature, other, or none, with confidence; label is null when unsure). reports (needs reports=): does this review say that the thing you describe happened (p, 0 to 1). incentivized: does the reviewer say they got the product free, discounted or rewarded for the review (p), and did the text carry a disclosure such as 'in exchange for my honest review', Vine or 체험단 (disclosed). injection flags text that addresses an AI system and tries to direct it (flagged, p); it never drops or rewrites a row. These are signals to read, never a verdict on a review or a reviewer. A review that could not be judged carries labels: null. Reviews already labelled for anyone are free, and so is a cached page. data.labels reports what was judged and billed.
- `reports` *(optional)*: Required by label=reports, ignored otherwise. What to look for, in plain words, up to 300 characters, for example reports=the battery drains quickly or reports=배송이 늦음. Every review gains labels.reports.p, the probability that it says so, in any wording or language. Without it label=reports is skipped with the warning label_reports_needs_reports and is not billed.
- `judgments` *(optional)*: Optional, on (the default) or off. By default every row gains free SocialCrawl judgments (computed.labels, and computed.relevance on search endpoints), reported in data.labels (mode default) and data.relevance (origin default), each with a status (complete, partial or skipped) and pending: the rows still being judged when the page was sent, which carry null now and are filled on your next call or cached read. Default judgments never add credits, never change an existing field, and never drop or reorder a row. off returns the page exactly as before, with none of those keys. label=none does the same.
- `dry_run` *(optional)*: Optional. When 1, return a cost preview for this labelled or relevance-filtered request without fetching the page or judging any row. data.estimate reports rows_expected, rows_cached, label_credits_min, label_credits_max and base_credits. 0 credits charged.
- `label_evidence` *(optional)*: Optional, only with label=. When 1, every labelled row also carries computed.labels_evidence.<preset> = { quote, sentence_index }: the sentence in the row that most clearly shows the label, copied verbatim. Absent or null when no single sentence shows it.
- `fit` *(optional)*: Optional. When goal, keep the rows and fields needed for the goal you pass in goal= (plus any that are uncertain, and the first and last), and replace the rest with a stub. data.held_back lists the held ids and a recall id that re-reads the full page from cache at no extra charge. Without this param the page is unchanged.
- `goal` *(optional)*: Required by fit=goal. What you are trying to do, in your own words, up to 300 characters.
- `fit_tokens` *(optional)*: Optional, only with fit=goal. Soft cap on how much of the page to keep, in tokens. Uncertain blocks and the first and last block are kept even if they exceed it.
- `cursor` *(optional)*: Universal pagination cursor. Send `pagination.next_cursor` from the previous response back verbatim: the API maps it to this endpoint's native `page` (page style). You never construct, decode, or look up a cursor. Omit it for page 1.
- `product_id` / `url` — at least one required.
  - `product_id`: AliExpress product id, the numeric id in a product URL: aliexpress.com/item/3256812847028710.html is product id 3256812847028710. Product ids also come back on every row of GET /v1/aliexpress/search and GET /v1/aliexpress/search/hot. (one of: product_id, url; at least one required)
  - `url`: Full AliExpress product URL, for example https://www.aliexpress.com/item/3256812847028710.html. The product id is extracted from the path. (one of: product_id, url; at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/aliexpress/reviews?product_id=<product_id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /product/shipping — 5cr

Returns shipping fee, origin country, and min/max delivery days for one product SKU and a ship-to country. sku_id comes back on every product row. Optional price is the sale price used for free-shipping thresholds. Default tax_rate is 0.

**Parameters**

- `sku_id`: SKU id for a colour or size variant. Comes back on every product as sku_id.
- `country` *(optional)*: Ship-to country as a two-letter code. Default US. Changes displayed price and availability. A product that exists for US can return empty for another country.
- `currency` *(optional)*: ISO 4217 currency for displayed prices. Default USD. Live-validated: USD GBP CAD EUR UAH MXN TRY RUB BRL AUD INR JPY IDR SEK KRW ILS THB CLP VND.
- `language` *(optional)*: Copy language as an ISO code. Default EN. Live-validated: EN RU PT ES FR ID IT TH JA AR VI TR DE HE KO NL PL MX CL IN.
- `price` *(optional)*: Sale price in the target currency, used for free-shipping calculation.
- `tax_rate` *(optional)*: Tax rate as a decimal, for example 0.1. Default 0.
- `product_id` / `url` — at least one required.
  - `product_id`: AliExpress product id, the numeric id in a product URL: aliexpress.com/item/3256812847028710.html is product id 3256812847028710. Product ids also come back on every row of GET /v1/aliexpress/search and GET /v1/aliexpress/search/hot. (one of: product_id, url; at least one required)
  - `url`: Full AliExpress product URL, for example https://www.aliexpress.com/item/3256812847028710.html. The product id is extracted from the path. (one of: product_id, url; at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/aliexpress/product/shipping?sku_id=<sku_id>&product_id=<product_id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

- `currency` *(optional)*: ISO 4217 currency for displayed prices. Default USD. Live-validated: USD GBP CAD EUR UAH MXN TRY RUB BRL AUD INR JPY IDR SEK KRW ILS THB CLP VND.
- `language` *(optional)*: Copy language as an ISO code. Default EN. Live-validated: EN RU PT ES FR ID IT TH JA AR VI TR DE HE KO NL PL MX CL IN.

### /search/promo — 5cr

Returns products in a named AliExpress promotion. Promotion names come from GET /v1/aliexpress/promo. Same row shape as search.

**Parameters**

- `promotion_name`: Promotion name exactly as returned by GET /v1/aliexpress/promo, for example New Arrival.
- `page` *(optional)*: Page number, starting at 1. Prefer the universal cursor parameter. Native upstream cursor param. Send the universal `cursor` instead: the API maps it to this name for you.
- `page_size` *(optional)*: Products per page, 1 to 50. Default 10.
- `sort_by` *(optional)*: Result ordering: price_low, price_high, most_sold, or least_sold.
- `category_id` *(optional)*: Optional category id to narrow the promotion.
- `country` *(optional)*: Ship-to country as a two-letter code. Default US. Changes displayed price and availability. A product that exists for US can return empty for another country.
- `currency` *(optional)*: ISO 4217 currency for displayed prices. Default USD. Live-validated: USD GBP CAD EUR UAH MXN TRY RUB BRL AUD INR JPY IDR SEK KRW ILS THB CLP VND.
- `language` *(optional)*: Copy language as an ISO code. Default EN. Live-validated: EN RU PT ES FR ID IT TH JA AR VI TR DE HE KO NL PL MX CL IN.
- `cursor` *(optional)*: Universal pagination cursor. Send `pagination.next_cursor` from the previous response back verbatim: the API maps it to this endpoint's native `page` (page style). You never construct, decode, or look up a cursor. Omit it for page 1.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/aliexpress/search/promo?promotion_name=<promotion_name>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /categories — 1cr

Returns the AliExpress category tree: parent and subcategory ids and names. Use a category_id on search or search/hot.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/aliexpress/categories" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /promo — 1cr

Returns currently featured promotion names and product counts. Pass promo_name to GET /v1/aliexpress/search/promo.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/aliexpress/promo" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
